messages:
Ana (sec-eng): Quick alert: after yesterday's RBAC prune we observed brief mTLS handshake failures in staging-eu when the rotator restarted.
Diego (infra): Any log snippet?
Ana (sec-eng): Proxy log: 
```
2026-05-04T11:59:01Z proxy-eu tls: unwrap failed: KMS AccessDenied principal=role/rotator-role key=alias/region-keystore
```
Sam (sre): Correlates with a 45s spike of 502s svc-collector -> svc-parser at 11:59. Canary nodes hit first.
AuditBot: ALERT KMS_DENY_1789: 14 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/rotator-role between 2026-05-04T11:58:45Z and 2026-05-04T11:59:30Z. Logs saved to /logs/sec/kms/2026-05-04/KMS_DENY_1789.json
Diego (infra): Mitigation: timeboxed infra patch to grant kms:Decrypt to service-account/proxy-fanout for alias/region-keystore for 20m via pipeline + bump proxy cache TTL to 4m on canary. No console edits.
Sam (sre): Running emergency job: `./infra/iam-quickpatch --grant "proxy-fanout:kms:Decrypt:alias/region-keystore" --duration 20m --tag incident-mtls-eu-staging`
Sam (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/4, cache TTL adjusted. Error rate returned to baseline ~30s after patch. No further denies recorded.
Ana (sec-eng): Postmortem items: add RBAC preflight that simulates kms:Decrypt as rotator principal, increase default proxy cache TTL, implement rotator fallback to cached chain on decrypt failure, add CI fault-injection for KMS Deny, and retain KMS deny logs for 90 days.
Diego (infra): I'll open infra PR for the preflight check and add an observability gate: fail canary if KMS Deny > 0 for 1m.
Sam (sre): Linking incident SEC-5011 once postmortem is up. Closing unless further alerts. :lock:
